timeline.body: Out of curiosity, should we just *add* `/_health` and `/_health/{indicator}` to the paths so we have a period during which both URLs work? Then at a later time (9.x?) we can remove the `/_internal/health` path?

reply.body:
That's a very interesting idea.
I do worry that not ALL our `_internal` APIs will be internal/experimental/not-GA anymore should we choose to do this though. The current invariant of `DO NOT USE` for the `_internal` APIs (irrespective of reading the docs) is quite valuable IMO.
edit: hmm, although we wouldn't document the `_internal` path

timeline.body: LGTM (with all the caveats about synchronizing this with the UI team, unless we decide to make the path parts additive)
